title: Wild_LIFE corrected RAG / few-shot corpus
purpose: Pins the CORRECTED Wild_LIFE sources that the AI assistant layer (brief Layer 2) may use as retrieval context and few-shot exemplars. The corrupted PUBLISHED exemplar is formally barred — see BANNED.md. This manifest is the allow-list; BANNED.md is the deny-list.

approved_sources.produced_by: pilot/wildlife/regen/regen.py (Model P, deterministic, validated strict-P green)
approved_sources.what: The canonical Model-P Wild_LIFE workbench: validated tree-faithful source on the orphan SourceCode branch (one commit + one annotated tag per release), canonical metadata. Reproducible from committed inputs.
The canonical 4-release version_history.csv (vhcsv-written, exact §8 header). The authoritative curated history.
Canonical CodeMeta 2.0. @context = https://doi.org/10.5063/schema/codemeta-2.0 (the swh-indexer-accepted context, D9). Uses funder (not funding); no ad-hoc fields.

The six curator-approved curatorial decisions (AppleDouble exclusion, absolute/relative symlink preservation, perm documentation, curator-email opt-in, inferred dates). Provenance-tagged, ratified per decisions.md §1.02-RATIFY.

Tree-fidelity oracles: 0.90/0.91/1.0 are the frozen tarball-derived fixtures (independent provenance); 1.02 is the derived curated Model-P tag-tree oracle. NOTE: fixtures/wildlife/manifests/1.02.json is the QUARANTINED census (forensic record), not a few-shot exemplar.

canonical_codemeta_context.policy: D9 — the validator's accepted-context set is vendored from swh-indexer source, never a hardcoded constant. A 4.0 context is NOT yet accepted and would be silently dropped (C2 hazard).
